assignments.name: data.assessment
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const parts = $('Get linked participants').all().map(p => p.json); if (!parts.length) return {}; const pid = parts[0].id_fields.Id; const asses = $('Tag assessment with participant').all().map(x => x.json).filter(x => x._participant_id === pid).sort((x,y) => y.id_fields.Id - x.id_fields.Id); const af = asses[0] ? asses[0].fields : {}; return { needs_summary: af.needs_summary, position: af.position }; })() }}

assignments.name: data.a
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const parts = $('Get linked participants').all().map(p => p.json); if (!parts.length) return {}; const pid = parts[0].id_fields.Id; const asses = $('Tag assessment with participant').all().map(x => x.json).filter(x => x._participant_id === pid).sort((x,y) => y.id_fields.Id - x.id_fields.Id); const af = asses[0] ? asses[0].fields : {}; return { o: af.cefr_overall, r: af.cefr_range, a: af.cefr_accuracy, f: af.cefr_fluency, c: af.cefr_communication }; })() }}

assignments.name: data.recomendation
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const parts = $('Get linked participants').all().map(p => p.json); if (!parts.length) return {}; const pid = parts[0].id_fields.Id; const recs = $('Tag recommendation with participant').all().map(x => x.json).filter(x => x._participant_id === pid).sort((x,y) => y.id_fields.Id - x.id_fields.Id); const rf = recs[0] ? recs[0].fields : {}; return { headline: rf.headline, rationale: rf.rationale }; })() }}

assignments.name: data.participants
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const parts = $('Get linked participants').all().map(p => p.json); const asses = $('Tag assessment with participant').all().map(x => x.json); const recs = $('Tag recommendation with participant').all().map(x => x.json); return parts.map(p => { const pid = p.id_fields.Id; const a = asses.filter(x => x._participant_id === pid).sort((x,y) => y.id_fields.Id - x.id_fields.Id)[0]; const r = recs.filter(x => x._participant_id === pid).sort((x,y) => y.id_fields.Id - x.id_fields.Id)[0]; const af = a ? a.fields : {}; return { full_name: p.fields.full_name, position: p.fields.position, a: { o: af.cefr_overall, r: af.cefr_range, a: af.cefr_accuracy, f: af.cefr_fluency, c: af.cefr_communication }, assessment: { needs_summary: af.needs_summary, position: af.position }, recommendation: r ? { headline: r.fields.headline, rationale: r.fields.rationale } : {} }; }); })() }}
